articles.title: FX option expiries for 30 September 10am New York cut
articles.description: There are two notable expiry levels to watch out for on the day, as highlighted in bold below. The first one is for EUR/USD at the 1.1300 level, with the strike sitting roughly 30 pips away from the spot price. The expiry size is meaningful and with price already relatively close, there may be some pull towards 1.1300 as the cut approaches. That especially if the dollar continues to push higher, with the selloff in Treasuries still underpinning the currency. Just keep in mind though that the June low for EUR/USD at 1.1324 is a key technical consideration too. That is providing strong support on the daily chart, so sellers will have to decisively break that in trying to convince of a stronger push towards 1.1300. But if EUR/USD pushes higher during the session ahead, the above expiry's influence should diminish fairly quickly. That as the price movement will also reinforce a defense of the key technical level outlined at 1.1324. Then, there is one for USD/JPY at the 157.00 level with the spot price sitting less than 15 pips relative to the strike currently. The combination of its size and proximity means 157.00 could act as a pinning level through the European session and into the cut later. In other words, any modest downside move could see option-related flows help pull USD/JPY back towards the strike. Meanwhile, attempts to move significantly away from 157.00 may face some opposing hedging flows. But as mentioned above, dollar sentiment is also key today with watchful eyes on the bond market and whether long-end yields will continue to break higher. Besides that, month-end and quarter-end flows will also be a consideration that could inject further volatility to price movements as we navigate through the session ahead. That will be something to keep in mind just in case we do see exacerbated price movements across major pairs. For more information on how to use this data, you may refer to this post here and/or refer to the Q&A below. This article was written by Justin Low at investinglive.com.

articles.title: Horoscope for Wednesday, September 30, 2026
articles.description: Moon Alert Avoid shopping (except food and gas) and important decisions until 1 p.m. After that, there are no restrictions to shopping or important decisions today. The moon is in Gemini. Aries (March 21-April 19) A positive day A busy, chatty day! Your communication skills are excellent. Wait until the moon alert is over to commit to any important decisions or ideas. Tap into your creative talents today. It's also a lovely day to schmooze and enjoy sports and kids' activities. Taurus (April 20-May 20) A positive day After the moon alert today, you're on your game when it comes to financial matters, shopping, and wheeling and dealing. In particular, you have energy to make home improvements, especially to recycling, garbage areas, plumbing, and bathrooms. Gemini (May 21-June 20) A dynamic day Today, the moon is in your sign dancing with Mars, Neptune and Pluto, which is empowering. You have lots of mental energy to talk to others and get things done. You'll enjoy socializing. You might convince someone to see your views about politics, religion or philosophical ideas. Cancer (June 21-July 22) A positive day Family discussions and home repairs are on your mind, and today you might use some persuasion to improve your finances. Be clear when talking to bosses and authority figures. Accept invitations to socialize today because you're happy to talk to someone and share your ideas. Leo (July 23-Aug. 22) A positive day Discussions with friends, groups, and organizations will be lively today! You might discuss a makeover or improving something. This is a high-energy day full of appointments, errands, and productivity, especially after the moon alert is over. Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22) A positive day People notice you today, which is a good thing because you make an excellent impression on everyone. Others see you as positive, friendly, breezy and yet powerful. If you're in a position to help someone, you will. Postpone financial decisions until after the moon alert today. (See above.) Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22) A dynamic day The sun and Mercury are in your sign, which makes you eager to get out and talk to someone. Issues related to politics, religion, higher education, medicine and the law might be an important discussion today. Romance is also in the mix. Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21) A positive day Be aware of the restrictions of the moon alert today. However, after that, go after what you want! You're in a strong position today and you might use your money, resources and influence to help someone at work. You might also make improvements at home. It's your call. Sagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21) A positive day You might have to go more than halfway when dealing with others today, which is a small thing. Discussions about travel, publishing and education will appeal. Meanwhile, this is a popular day for you. Enjoy the company of younger people. Discussions with partners and spouses might be intense. Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19) A positive day You make a great impression on everyone at this time because the sun is high in your chart. (This happens only once a year for four weeks.) This is a productive day. Discussions about finances and shared property will go your way. Relations with a friend might be flirtatious. Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18) A positive day Although relations with partners and spouses might require patience, this is actually a fun-loving, sociable day for you. Make an effort to enjoy the company of others. Explore new ideas about politics, religion, higher education, medicine and the law. It's also a flirtatious, romantic day! Pisces (Feb. 19-March 20) A positive day You might prefer to relax at home today, although something might interrupt your routine. Travel will appeal. You also have a lot of energy to make home improvements and possibly some elegant purchases — after the moon alert is over. (See above.) If today is your birthday Actress Marion Cotillard (1975) shares your birthday today. You value justice and honesty. You're fair-minded, focused, and compassionate. This is a year of work and building foundations both internally and externally. Simplicity is key. Take charge of your health. Explore martial arts or yoga because exercise will play an important role. Stay grounded and levelheaded.
